screening_purpose: Find an unedited same-frame source where a visible subject exits and an inherited environmental trace remains.

candidates.title: Silhouette Footage Of A Person Walking Away
candidates.creator: Ricky Esquivel

direct_visual_review.evidence: Complete 120-sample dense sheet covering 0.000-24.117 seconds at approximately 4.94 fps.
observations: 0.0-1.8 seconds: the silhouetted person crosses extremely close to the lens and temporarily occludes most of the sunset.
2.0-7.9 seconds: the person resolves from a partial body into a centered silhouette and raises one arm.
8.1-24.1 seconds: the person remains centered; head and shoulders continue small motion against a slowly changing sky.
direct_visual_review.inference: The source contains presence and gesture but no subject exit and no inherited empty-frame trace.

rejection_reasons: The subject never leaves the frame.
The final state is continued presence, not absence.
Using the opening occlusion as a disappearance would reverse the source event and violate the no-reverse guardrail.
candidates.possible_other_use: A separate silhouette-entry or gesture-hold experiment, not the current absence Operator.

candidates.title: Man Walking Towards Camera in Scenic Landscape
candidates.creator: Burak Bahadır Büyükkılınç

direct_visual_review.evidence: Complete 150-sample dense sheet covering 0.000-37.731 seconds at approximately 3.95 fps.
observations: The man begins as a small distant subject near the lower center.
He approaches steadily while the camera and mountain composition remain fixed.
At the final sampled frame he is still visible near the lower center.
direct_visual_review.inference: The take supports approach and scale progression but never reaches absence.

rejection_reasons: The subject remains present in the last state.
There is no empty same-frame consequence after his approach.

candidates.title: Woman Walking on the Beach
candidates.creator: Taryn Elliott

direct_visual_review.evidence: Complete 150-sample dense sheet covering 0.000-30.197 seconds at approximately 4.93 fps.
observations: 0.0-10.1 seconds: the frame is empty of the foreground subject while water, distant lights, and reflections remain active.
10.3-16.4 seconds: a woman enters from frame right, walks left across the reflective water, and fully exits frame left.
16.6-30.2 seconds: the same composition remains empty while water and warm reflections continue moving.
direct_visual_review.inference: The source contains a complete environment → presence → absence event and a visible inherited trace.

selection_reasons: The subject fully leaves the frame in chronological source order.
The same water surface and distant lights continue moving after the exit.
The empty hold is native source motion, not a freeze, duplicated frame, or unrelated insert.
The fixed 16:9 composition should be preserved instead of forcing a vertical crop that would hide the entrance and exit.
